title: Special UFO briefing for maintenance teams

tellings.quote: This time they brought us into a special briefing and they told us there's UFOs out in the area.

plain: In 1967 at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, home to nuclear missiles, maintenance crews were called into a special briefing and told "there's UFOs out in the area," according to a man named Robert Jameson, who was on one of those teams. A former Air Force officer named Robert Salas, who served at the base, relays Jameson's account to Michels. If true, it would mean the Air Force knew of unknown objects near its nuclear sites and warned its own people.
